text.tspan: aurora_editor — Standalone desktop application (built with Dioxus)
for browsing and editing Aurora models, including live validation and
Aurora Model Source Files — Aurora model source-of-truth files
stored as JSJSON: a mission card plus per-card files under
Desktop UI Shell — Ability to present a desktop application UI
with a stable three-pane layout and shared selection state.
Navigation and Focus Management — Ability to navigate the model by
card id and keep the focused card synchronized across panes.
Context Graph Visualization — Ability to visualize a local subgraph
around the focused card (including parent, siblings, and children)
Interactive Card Editing — Ability to edit card fields and
links interactively while maintaining model invariants and
Markdown Preview and Audit View — Ability to render the focused card
as a readable Markdown-style document with link list, and to inspect
aurora_shared Integration — Ability to reuse aurora_shared for
model discovery/loading, validation, rendering, and file layout
conventions to keep editor behavior consistent with CLI tooling.
Dioxus App Shell — Top-level Dioxus component that owns the UI
shell layout and routes focus/selection changes between panes.
Explorer Tree Pane — Left navigation pane that presents a tree view
derived from shortest paths from the mission root, enabling fast card
Brain Graph Pane — Central pane that renders a mind-map /
TheBrain-style context graph with the focused card centered and related
Inspector Pane — Right pane that splits vertically: top half edits
the focused card; bottom half shows a rendered Markdown-style preview
(and links) with a tab to reveal audit details.
Model Session and Persistence — In-memory model session that loads a
workspace model home, computes shortest paths, validates changes, and
persists updated card files using aurora_shared semantics.
Visual Model Authoring — Enable rapid comprehension and editing of
an Aurora model through a visual, multi-pane editor that reduces
Reuse Shared Aurora Semantics — Minimize duplicated logic and
inconsistencies across tooling surfaces by reusing the aurora_shared
library for model discovery, parsing, validation, and rendering.
Workspace File System — Filesystem-backed store holding Aurora model
source files (Mission card plus per-card JSJSON files) within a
Three Pane Shell — Render the editor UI as three primary panes:
left navigation tree, central context graph, and right inspector
Compute Shortest Path Tree — Compute a stable shortest-path parent for
each card from the mission root and present it as a tree for navigation
Brain Style Graph View — Render a TheBrain-like local context view:
focused card centered; show parent from the chosen shortest-path
chain; show siblings (same card_type) as adjacent nodes linked from
the parent; show focused card’s outgoing links as navigable
Card Inspector Editing — Edit the focused card’s core fields
(name, description, type/subtype, status, attributes, and links)
Preview and Audit Panel — Render a Markdown-style card preview
(including outgoing link list) and provide a tab to display audit trail
Load, Validate, and Save Models — Load Aurora models from a chosen
workspace, validate invariants on every change, and persist edits back
to JSJSON card files using shared aurora_shared semantics.
Dioxus UI Framework API — UI framework interface used to declare
layouts, render widgets, and process user events for the standalone
aurora_shared Domain API — Public domain interface (Rust API) for
discovering model homes, loading cards, validating invariants, and
Local Filesystem API — Contract for reading and writing
Aurora model files on the local filesystem (open, read, write,
Standalone Editor — Provide a standalone application capable of
creating and manipulating Aurora models visually, reusing the
Three Pane Layout — The editor SHALL present a three-pane layout
(similar to Visual Studio or Obsidian): left navigation tree, central
Shortest Path Tree Navigation — The editor SHALL provide a left-pane
tree view for navigation, where the tree is derived from a chosen
shortest path from the mission root to each card.
Brain Style Graph Navigation — The editor SHALL provide a central
mind-map / TheBrain style view with the focused card centered. The
view SHALL show the parent (from the chosen shortest-path chain), and
MAY show siblings (same card_type) linked from that parent even if
they are not linked to the focused card.
Edit, Preview, and Audit Inspector — The editor SHALL provide a
right-pane inspector: the top half edits the focused card; the bottom
half renders a Markdown-style view of the card (including links). The
bottom half SHALL provide a tab to reveal the card’s audit trail
Dioxus UI — The standalone editor SHOULD be implemented using
Dioxus as the primary UI library.
Reuse aurora_shared — The editor SHALL reuse aurora_shared for
model discovery/loading and validation/rendering semantics to stay
Safe Workspace Persistence — The editor SHALL persist edits to model
files in a safe manner that avoids partial writes and preserves schema
validity (e.g., atomic replace per card file).
